questions.question: While ______ the experiment, the researchers discovered an unexpected result.
questions.explanation: while + 분사구문 (주어 동일) → 준동사(-ing). ④는 주어가 없어 문법적으로 불완전.

questions.question: The fact that he ______ late surprised everyone.
questions.explanation: that절 내부 → 완전한 절 → 본동사 필요.

questions.question: ______ no evidence to support his claim, he withdrew his argument.
It is important that every student ______ the rules.
She pretended ______ the answer, although she actually didn’t.
When ______ properly, the machine can operate efficiently.
questions.explanation: 분사구문(수동) → When it is used 생략.

questions.question: The reason why he failed ______ not clear yet.
I heard the door ______ suddenly in the middle of the night.
______ what to do, she asked her teacher for advice.
No sooner ______ the announcement than the audience began to cheer.
questions.explanation: No sooner + 도치 (조동사 + 주어 + 동사) → 본동사 포함한 도치 구조.
